name: tinto-bus-company-itineraries
description: Producing the plain, day-by-day pickup/dropoff schedule a tour's transport supplier actually works from. A standalone plugin, open to anyone on the team who needs it. Rebuilt 2026-09-16 against a real reference document and new Airtable fields, then extended 2026-09-17 to cover five destination-specific formats (language and layout vary by destination); then given a 2026-09-24 onboarding check-in that tells Tamara up front which destinations already have a template and which don't; no longer the original placeholder design.
